draft.stem: As shown in the figure, which labelled amine gives a positive carbylamine test with $\text{CHCl}_3$ and alcoholic $\text{KOH}$?

figure.description: Draw four separate amine structures in a clearly spaced 2 × 2 grid, in reading order from top left to bottom right. Label each structure directly beneath it with a large, distinct Roman numeral: I, II, III, IV, respectively. I: dimethylamine, (CH3)2NH, with nitrogen bonded to two methyl groups and one hydrogen. II: ethylamine, CH3CH2NH2, with nitrogen bonded to one ethyl group and two hydrogens. III: trimethylamine, (CH3)3N, with nitrogen bonded to three methyl groups and no hydrogens. IV: N-methylaniline, C6H5NHCH3, with nitrogen bonded to a phenyl group, a methyl group, and one hydrogen. Keep all structures and labels separate and fully legible.
